config.loadingLists: Shown while the newsletter lists are being fetched from the plugin's own server. Ends with an ellipsis character.
config.noLists: Shown when the fetch succeeded but returned nothing — almost always because the connection settings have not been saved yet. One sentence that says what to do.
config.loadFailed: Fallback when the fetch itself failed and the server gave no message. No trailing period.
config.subscribers: Count of subscribers on one newsletter list, shown after the number. PLURAL — {count} is the number. Polish needs three forms (one | few | many). Glossary: subscriber → subskrybent.
config.availableFields: Heading above the legend of {{token}} placeholders under a Discord (or similar) message template field. Noun phrase, ≤3 words. Tells the operator which fields the engine fills in automatically.
discord.displayName: Title of the Discord plugin card. Product name — stays 'Discord' in both languages.
discord.description: One sentence under that title: personalized Discord messages on selected CRM events. Glossary: lead stays 'lead'.
discord.config.url.label: Label of the Discord incoming-webhook URL field. ≤2 words. 'Webhook' stays as-is (glossary).
discord.config.url.description: Helper under it: the URL comes from Discord channel settings (Incoming Webhooks). One short sentence.
discord.config.username.label: Label of the optional display-name override for the webhook bot. ≤3 words.
discord.config.username.description: Helper: optional; when set, overrides the webhook's default name on each message. One sentence.
discord.config.events.label: Label over the checkbox group choosing which CRM events notify Discord. Noun phrase in Polish, ≤3 words.
discord.config.events.description: Helper under the event checkboxes. One short sentence.
discord.config.events.options.formSubmit: Checkbox label: form submitted. ≤3 words. Glossary: submission → zgłoszenie if needed, but prefer short.
discord.config.events.options.leadCreate: Checkbox label: new lead. ≤3 words. Glossary: lead stays.
discord.config.events.options.leadMoved: Checkbox label: lead moved between stages. ≤3 words.
discord.config.template.description: Helper under every message-template textarea: leave empty to keep the built-in default. One short sentence.
discord.config.template.contactCreated: Label of the textarea for the new-contact message template. ≤4 words.
discord.config.template.formSubmitted: Label of the textarea for the form-submitted message template. ≤4 words.
discord.config.template.leadCreated: Label of the textarea for the new-lead message template. ≤4 words.
discord.config.template.leadMoved: Label of the textarea for the lead-moved message template. ≤4 words.
discord.config.template.leadDeleted: Label of the textarea for the lead-deleted message template. ≤4 words.
discord.placeholders.email: Legend line describing {{email}} — contact email address. ≤4 words.
discord.placeholders.name: Legend line describing {{name}} — contact display name. ≤4 words.
discord.placeholders.id: Legend line describing {{id}} — contact UUID. ≤3 words.
discord.placeholders.formName: Legend line describing {{formName}} — human form title. ≤3 words.
discord.placeholders.formSlug: Legend line describing {{formSlug}} — form URL slug. ≤3 words.
discord.placeholders.submissionId: Legend line describing {{submissionId}}. Glossary: submission → zgłoszenie. ≤3 words.
discord.placeholders.title: Legend line describing {{title}} — lead title. ≤3 words.
discord.placeholders.stageName: Legend line describing {{stageName}} — current pipeline stage name. ≤4 words.
discord.placeholders.value: Legend line describing {{value}} — lead monetary value. ≤3 words.
discord.placeholders.oldStageName: Legend line describing {{oldStageName}} — stage before a move. ≤4 words.
discord.placeholders.newStageName: Legend line describing {{newStageName}} — stage after a move. ≤4 words.
actions.refresh: Button that re-fetches the data of the plugin screen it sits on. Used by the plugin list and by the Listmonk list view. Imperative, ≤2 words.
actions.refreshing: Label that button shows while the re-fetch is in flight. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words — it must fit the same button.
list.title: Page heading of the installed-plugins screen. Noun, plural, 1 word. Glossary: plugin → wtyczka.
list.subtitle: One sentence under that heading saying what the screen is for. Polish is a noun phrase ('Zarządzanie…'), not an address to the reader.
list.installed: Small line on a plugin card giving the day it was installed. {date} is rendered by d() — never format it in the message. ≤2 words plus the value.
list.configure: Button on a plugin card that expands its configuration form. This is the label shown while the form is collapsed; the expanded state uses common.actions.close. Imperative, 1 word.
list.enableToConfigure: Hint inside the expand panel when a custom settings UI (MCP / AI Compose / Pokelo) is opened while the plugin is still off — those APIs require the plugin enabled. One short sentence, impersonal.
list.enabled: Status word next to a plugin's on/off switch when the plugin is on. 1 word, and it must fit a narrow fixed-width slot. It always describes a plugin, so Polish agrees with 'wtyczka' (feminine).
list.disabled: The same slot when the plugin is off. 1 word. Polish agrees with 'wtyczka' (feminine).
list.enableAria: aria-label of that switch while the plugin is off, i.e. what a click would do. {name} is the plugin's display name and comes from the API untranslated.
list.disableAria: aria-label of that switch while the plugin is on. {name} is the plugin's display name and comes from the API untranslated. Replaces a concatenation of 'Disable ' and the name.
list.empty.title: Empty-state title when the server has no plugins at all. ≤3 words.
list.empty.message: Body under it. One sentence: plugins are installed on the server, not from this screen.
toast.enabled: Toast confirming a plugin was switched on. A WHOLE sentence per branch — never interpolate 'enabled/disabled' into shared prose, because Polish adjectives must agree with their noun. {name} is the plugin's display name from the API.
toast.disabled: Toast confirming a plugin was switched off. A whole sentence, for the same reason as toast.enabled. {name} is the plugin's display name from the API.
errors.load: Fallback in the error banner when the plugin list could not be fetched and the server gave no message. No trailing period.
errors.toggle: Fallback when switching a plugin on or off failed and the server gave no message. It covers both directions, so it must not name one. No trailing period.
errors.saveConfig: Fallback when saving a plugin's configuration failed and the server gave no message. No trailing period.
listmonk.displayName: Title of the Listmonk plugin's card in the plugin list. The plugin declares this key and the backend seeds the English literal into the database; the key wins wherever the SPA knows it (ADR-0011). 'Listmonk' is a product name and stays as-is.
listmonk.description: One sentence under that title saying what the plugin does: contacts and form submissions end up on Listmonk lists. Glossary: submission → zgłoszenie.
listmonk.nav: Sidebar and command-palette label of the screen this plugin adds. 1 word, must fit the collapsed sidebar. Glossary: newsletter stays 'newsletter'.
listmonk.config.url.label: Label of the field holding the address of the operator's own Listmonk server. ≤2 words. Glossary: URL stays 'URL' in English; Polish says 'adres'.
listmonk.config.url.description: Helper line under it: the value is the instance's base address, not a specific API path. One short sentence.
listmonk.config.user.label: Label of the Listmonk login field. ≤2 words.
listmonk.config.password.label: Label of the Listmonk password field. 1 word. Glossary: password → hasło.
webhook.displayName: Title of the Webhook plugin's card in the plugin list. 'Webhook' is a technical identifier and is NOT translated in either language (glossary).
webhook.description: One sentence under it: the plugin POSTs CRM events as JSON. 'POST' and 'JSON' stay as-is.
webhook.config.url.label: Label of the field holding the address events are POSTed to. ≤2 words. Glossary: endpoint stays 'endpoint' (Polish inflects it: 'endpointu').
webhook.config.url.description: Helper line under it: every event goes to this one address as a JSON POST. One sentence.
webhook.config.secret.label: Label of the optional shared-secret field. ≤3 words. It names a value sent in an HTTP header, so Polish says where it goes rather than calquing 'secret header'.
webhook.config.secret.description: Helper line: the field may be left empty, and when set it travels as the X-Webhook-Secret header. The header name is an identifier and stays as-is in both languages.
listmonk.status.blocklisted: Badge on a contact whose email the newsletter tool has blocked. ≤1 word.
listmonk.status.subscriber: Badge on a contact that exists in the newsletter tool but is on no list. ≤1 word.
listmonk.status.subscribed: Badge on a contact that is on at least one newsletter list. ≤1 word.
listmonk.tooltip.lists: title attribute naming the lists a contact belongs to. {lists} is an already-joined, comma-separated list of names.
listmonk.tooltip.status: title attribute used instead when the contact is on no list. {status} is a raw value from the newsletter tool and stays untranslated.
mcp.displayName: Plugin card title for the MCP server integration. ≤3 words. MCP stays MCP.
mcp.description: One sentence under the card title: the plugin exposes read-only CRM tools to external AI agents over MCP.
mcp.nav: Sidebar / plugin nav label. ≤2 words. MCP stays MCP.
mcp.title: Page heading of the MCP plugin settings screen. ≤3 words.
mcp.subtitle: One sentence under that heading: generate a token and connect an AI agent. Mentions the link to the plugins list.
mcp.pluginsLink: Link at the end of the subtitle back to the plugins list. ≤3 words.
mcp.endpoint.title: Section heading for the MCP HTTP URL. ≤2 words.
mcp.endpoint.description: Helper line: paste this URL into the agent client. One short sentence.
mcp.token.title: Section heading for the access token. ≤2 words.
mcp.token.description: Helper: the token is shown once after generate/rotate; only a prefix is stored for display. One or two sentences.
mcp.token.prefixLabel: Label before the truncated token prefix. ≤2 words.
mcp.token.createdAt: Caption under the prefix. {date} is already formatted. One short clause.
mcp.token.none: Empty state when no token has been generated yet. One short sentence.
mcp.token.revealedWarning: Warning banner when the full token is on screen — copy it now, it will not be shown again. One sentence.
mcp.token.revokeTitle: Confirm-dialog title for revoking the token. ≤3 words.
mcp.token.revokeConfirm: Confirm-dialog body: agents will lose access until a new token is generated. One sentence.
mcp.actions.copy: Button that copies text to the clipboard. 1 word.
mcp.actions.generate: Primary button when no token exists yet. ≤2 words.
mcp.actions.rotate: Primary button when a token already exists — replaces it. ≤2 words.
mcp.actions.revoke: Destructive button / confirm label that invalidates the token. ≤2 words.
mcp.connect.title: Section heading with copy-paste snippets for AI clients. ≤3 words.
mcp.connect.description: Helper under that heading: replace the placeholder with your token after generating one. One sentence.
mcp.connect.claude: Label above the Claude Code CLI snippet. ≤3 words.
mcp.connect.cursor: Label above the Cursor .mcp.json snippet. ≤2 words.
mcp.connect.generic: Label above the generic HTTP headers snippet. ≤3 words.
mcp.errors.load: Fallback when token status could not be loaded. No trailing period.
mcp.errors.rotate: Fallback when generate/rotate failed. No trailing period.
mcp.errors.revoke: Fallback when revoke failed. No trailing period.
aiCompose.displayName: Product name shown in the plugin list and page header.
aiCompose.nav: Sidebar nav label for the AI Compose settings page (product name).
aiCompose.provider.title: Section heading for the AI provider configuration block.
aiCompose.provider.baseUrl.label: Form field label for the OpenAI-compatible base URL.
aiCompose.provider.apiKey.label: Form field label for the API key input.
aiCompose.provider.apiKey.placeholder: Placeholder text shown inside the API key input. Use an ellipsis to indicate a secret.
aiCompose.provider.saveButton: Button label to save provider settings.
aiCompose.provider.saving: Loading state for the save button. Ends with ellipsis character.
aiCompose.models.title: Section heading for the model selection block.
aiCompose.models.fetchButton: Button that fetches the list of available models from the provider.
aiCompose.models.fetching: Loading state while models are being fetched. Ends with ellipsis character.
aiCompose.models.allowList.label: Label for the multi-select chip list of permitted models.
aiCompose.models.defaultModel.label: Label for the default model select dropdown.
aiCompose.systemPrompt.title: Section heading for the optional system prompt override.
aiCompose.status.saved: Brief success confirmation shown after settings are saved.
pokelo.displayName: Product name shown in the plugin list and page header.
pokelo.nav: Sidebar nav label for the Pokelo settings page.
pokelo.title: Page title on the Pokelo settings screen.
pokelo.connection.title: Section heading for Pokelo URL and MCP token.
pokelo.connection.baseUrl.label: Form field label for the Pokelo API base URL.
pokelo.connection.token.label: Form field label for the MCP token input.
pokelo.connection.token.placeholder: Placeholder inside the token input. Use an ellipsis.
pokelo.connection.saveButton: Button label to save connection settings.
pokelo.connection.saving: Loading state for the save button. Ends with ellipsis character.
pokelo.project.title: Section heading for selecting bound Pokelo projects (multi-select).
pokelo.project.label: Label for the multi-select chip list of bound projects.
pokelo.project.empty: Empty state when the token returned no projects.
pokelo.project.refreshButton: Button that reloads projects from Pokelo.
pokelo.project.refreshing: Loading state while projects are being refreshed. Ends with ellipsis character.
pokelo.project.saveButton: Button label to save the selected projects.
pokelo.status.tokenConfigured: Badge when an MCP token is already stored.
pokelo.status.saved: Brief success confirmation after settings are saved.
pokelo.status.autoSelected: Hint when the only visible project was auto-bound. {name} is the project name.
hello.displayName: Title of the example plugin's Marketplace card and of its own page. It is a demonstration fixture, not a product — the name should read as an example, not as a feature. 'Hello' stays English in both languages (it is the package name).
hello.description: One sentence under that title: this plugin exists to show the install path working, and all it does is write a line to the log when a contact is created. Plain, no marketing.
